name: @cerebruminc/prisma-stable-sort-middleware
description: Guarantees stable sort order for all Prisma queries

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:compose:integration: npm run test:compose:integration:v5 && npm run test:compose:integration:v6 && npm run test:compose:integration:v7
scripts.test:compose:integration:v5: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml --profile with-sut-v5 up --build db sut --exit-code-from sut
scripts.test:compose:integration:v6: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml --profile with-sut-v6 up --build db sut-v6 --exit-code-from sut-v6
scripts.test:compose:integration:v7: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml --profile with-sut-v7 up --build db sut-v7 --exit-code-from sut-v7
scripts.setup:v7: prisma generate --config test/fixtures/prisma7/prisma.config.ts && prisma migrate deploy --config test/fixtures/prisma7/prisma.config.ts

author: Cerebrum <hello@cerebrum.com> (https://cerebrum.com)
